sprint_name: EOS Regression Verification, SFT Pipeline Correction & Controlled Recovery
status_summary: EOS regression verified at the raw token ID level (Base 10k: 0%, Step 50: 50%, Step 200: 70% first-token EOS rate). Pipeline formatting was unified across LocalModelSession and ConversationTemplate to eliminate out-of-distribution chat wrappers. Dataset provenance misattributions were fully resolved (TR-CD-01 derived from code_foundation.txt, TR-CD-02 from math_foundation.txt), achieving 100% source-grounding and strict document-level disjointness. Training gate remains BLOCKED to protect model weights until larger-scale SFT data (>500 records) is integrated. All 36 repository regression tests passed cleanly.

root_cause_findings.format_discrepancy: CONFIRMED - Batch 30 raw prompts vs session ChatML wrappers created embedding mismatch.
root_cause_findings.loss_alignment: REFUTED - Causal shift and assistant masking are mathematically sound.
root_cause_findings.dataset_overfitting: CONFIRMED - 37 examples over 10.8 epochs drove token 1 (EOS) to rank 1 probability.
root_cause_findings.stopping_artifact: REFUTED - Model genuinely emits token ID 1 at step 0.

Phase_3_Verify_Dataset_and_Provenance.corrections_made: TR-CD-01 re-derived from code_foundation.txt; TR-CD-02 re-derived from math_foundation.txt. Document overlap = 0, Prompt overlap = 0, Unsupported records = 0.

code_changes: chakrview/runtime/session.py: LocalModelSession.build_prompt_package unified to use canonical ConversationTemplate ChatML formatting.

Phase_6_Training_Readiness_Gate.rationale: Scaling training is gated until a large (>500 examples) balanced instruction dataset is ready, preventing premature EOS convergence.
